note: Objective headings per exam section, in exam order. The source also lists a Business Analyst objective under Creating Application Networks; it belongs to another exam and is left out.

sections.title: Creating Application Networks
objectives: Identify core architectural concepts of the application network and modern APIs.
Identify features of an API-led approach.
Identify features of MuleSoft's recommended operational model (C4E).
Apply correct processors and syntax to consume RAML-based RESTful web services, and predict outcomes.

sections.title: Designing APIs
objectives: Use REST API methods and resources.
Define REST API parameters and responses.
Identify when and how to define query parameters versus URI parameters.

sections.title: Accessing and Modifying Mule Events
objectives: Access and modify Mule event payloads with processors and DataWeave, and predict outcomes.
Access and modify Mule event attributes, and predict outcomes.
Access and modify Mule variables, and predict outcomes.
Enrich Mule events using Mule 4 connector targets, and predict outcomes.

sections.title: Structuring Mule Applications
objectives: Specify when and how to split Mule applications into separate configuration and properties files, and predict outcomes.
Specify when and how to pass events between flows and subflows using connectors and flow references, and predict outcomes.

sections.title: Building API Implementation Interfaces
objectives: Manually build API implementations from an API specification, RAML or not.
Predict the results of APIkit based on a RAML specification.
Implement correct responses based on a RAML specification, manually or with APIkit.

sections.title: Using Connectors
objectives: Connect to databases with the correct processors and syntax, and predict outcomes.
Connect to files or FTP servers with the correct processors and syntax, and predict outcomes.
Retrieve and combine data in the middle of a flow, and predict outcomes.

sections.title: Processing Records
objectives: Process individual records in a collection using For Each scopes, and predict outcomes.
Process individual records in a collection using batch scopes, and predict outcomes.
Process individual records in a collection using database listeners, and predict outcomes.
Persist data between flow executions.

sections.title: Transforming Data
objectives: Convert between output types and data types using DataWeave.
Predict the result of core DataWeave functions.
Write DataWeave transformations to coerce, format, order and filter data, and predict outcomes.
Call Mule flows from a DataWeave script.
Define, use and reuse DataWeave modules, functions and variables, and predict outcomes.

sections.title: Routing Events
objectives: Route messages using DataWeave conditions within a Choice router, and predict outcomes.
Scatter and gather messages, and predict outcomes.
Validate Mule events, and predict outcomes.

sections.title: Handling Errors
objectives: Implement global error handlers, and predict outcomes.
Implement On Error Continue and On Error Propagate handlers, and predict outcomes.
Combine multiple error handlers, and predict outcomes.
Implement Try scopes, and predict outcomes.
Map custom errors, and predict outcomes.

sections.title: Debugging and Troubleshooting Mule Applications
objectives: Identify root causes for errors when debugging Mule applications, and predict outcomes.

sections.title: Deploying and Managing APIs and Integrations
objectives: Deploy applications to CloudHub.
Manage APIs using separate proxies and autodiscovery.
Manage API policies.
